title: astilbe microphylla var. intermedia
intro: Astilbe microphylla var. intermedia, commonly known as False Goat's Beard, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the Saxifragaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Astilbe microphylla var. intermedia are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, soothe digestive issues, and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
